items.q: What is Jev, if it is not an LLM?
items.a: A **System One** model: typed questions in, **probabilities out**, ~200 ms. No strings, no chat, not multimodal in this stream. Named after **Jevons**: cheaper decisions should show up in more loops, not just cheaper chats.

items.q: What did the Mario/Doom tweets prove vs the Balatro stream?
items.a: Tweets show a real-time control loop is possible. The stream **does not win** Balatro. Menu clicks work. In-hand play stalls until the question is split.

items.q: What broke Jev before the model did?
items.a: **Dirty god view.** Overlay buttons marked enabled. `reason: unavailable` on enabled actions. ~21k-token dumps. He had to keep hand / score / plays / discards / chips / jokers and drop shop and deck.

items.q: What did vibe-coding the sidecar do?
items.a: The agent `JSON.stringify`'d **Play and Quit** and ran both. Primeagen: **vibed too close to the sun**. Coding model ≠ Jev.

items.q: Why can't you ask 'win Balatro' in one call?
items.a: Jev is a **classification engine**. Every prompt is **new**. High-level (play / discard / shop) then low-level (which cards, done). He calls it a **behavior tree**.
In the tree, not the model. Rules and strategy ride with the node or you resend them. History is not in the weights.
